title: U.S. hit with more foodborne illnesses as Chipotle, Qdoba remove salmonella-linked jalapeños
summary: The U.S. has been hit with another foodborne illness outbreak, as Chipotle, Qdoba and other restaurants pull jalapeños linked to salmonella. Meanwhile, officials are still struggling with a cyclosporiasis outbreak linked to iceberg lettuce. Shanelle Kaul has more.
